name: Murgado Ford of Chicago
climate: Chicago: harsh winters with sub-zero wind chills and lake-effect snow, heavy road salt from November through March (undercarriage corrosion), freeze-thaw potholes in March and April, sub-zero cold starts that strain oil and batteries, hot humid summers and dense stop-and-go traffic on the Kennedy Expressway.
brandNaming: Say 'genuine Ford parts' (the dealer's About Us wording); use 'Motorcraft' only for parts the dealer names as Motorcraft (synthetic blend oil and oil filter in its oil change offer, Motorcraft wiper blades)
Never write 'Ford Certified Technicians', 'certified technicians' or 'factory-trained', even though the dealer's own copy uses them; describe the work, not credentials

Use the dealer's service names as written: Quick Lane (/quick-lane), Express Service Lane (no appointment), Ford Mobile Service (/specials/mobile-service), Pickup & Delivery (/specials/pickup-delivery)
Ford Intelligent Oil-Life Monitor: service within 2 weeks or 500 miles of the oil-change message, reset after each service (Ford owner manual)
Current F-150 model year is 2026; do not cite the leaked 2027 F-150 order guide
Murgado Lincoln of Chicago shares the 2501 N Elston Ave building; do not mention Lincoln unless relevant, and never link the Lincoln page /service/lincoln-oil-change-services from a Ford article
The store was formerly Fox Ford of Chicago; mention only if relevant. Do not repeat About Us superlatives (such as 'Chicago's largest Ford inventory') as fact
